findings.evidence: Lines 166-204 mention only `A.ρ` and its subrepresentations; Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/Basic.lean defines `Representation k H V` under `[Semiring k] [Monoid H] [AddCommMonoid V] [Module k V]`, while Conjugate.lean:345-346 must pass `((forget₂ (FDRep k H) (Rep k H)).obj A)` solely to satisfy the bundled parameter.
findings.fix: State the core order isomorphism and irreducibility theorem for `ρ : Representation k H V` with `[AddCommMonoid V] [Module k V]`, then derive any `Rep`-specific wrappers if needed.
findings.issue: `resSubrepresentationOrderIso`, its two submodule lemmas, and `isIrreducible_comp_equiv_iff` require `A : Rep k H` even though every statement and proof uses only `A.ρ`; this prevents direct use with other representation bundles and causes the `FDRep` proof to manufacture a forgotten `Rep` at Conjugate.lean:345-346.

summary: The invariant-subspace and irreducibility results are unnecessarily restricted to bundled `Rep` objects, although their construction only depends on a raw representation.
